text: - A key-press focus check exists on the stand, in both layout modes: after a click on `crud-name` a `Key::Tab` press moves focus to `crud-surname` and Shift+Tab moves it back, the first Tab on a fresh boot focuses `back-btn`, nothing reads focused at boot or after a click on a heading, and each time exactly the focused control's snapshot node reads `focused` and it is the accessibility tree's focus (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:331-367) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-snapshot-state-fidelity/report.md

subject: keyboard-harness
text:
- A keyboard check runs on the stand in both layout modes, since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness: `stand_keyboard` walks each lean task's stated sequence (`tab_order`) forward and back with Tab and Shift+Tab, with wrap, the engine's focus, the snapshot's `focused` node and the tree's focus agreeing at every step — the engine's reading with the root element dropped, because `get_focussed_node_id` / `Harness::focused()` falls back to the root when nothing is focused and never reads `None` (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:674-677); Enter and Space on each focused stand button read as its click (16 rows) and keys that do not activate type or change nothing; fixture rows for the controls HTML gives the keys, a button disabled after it took focus taking no key and a button that is itself scrolled taking Enter as its own click; a click focusing each stand button with Tab continuing from it; a `disabled` attribute skipping a form control and not a `<div disabled tabindex=0>`; the CRUD list taking focus and its keys moving the selection; the Apple delete binding deleting on every OS; and an inert subtree skipped by Tab (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:337-365; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:367-423; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:710-789; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:850-877; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:889-930; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:932-992; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:994-1011; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:1027-1054); its readers `tab_order` and `focused` live in the stand checks' shared module (tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:47-63; tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:99-119); through the driver `stand_act_keys` presses `enter` and `space` on a Tab-focused `counter-increment` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_keys.rs:131-165)
 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md; since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions the walk is also asserted in two enabled states, each reached by keyboard alone (`enable_by_keyboard`) and walked in order against the shared table `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` — the flight booker after the return flight is chosen on `select#flight-type` by ArrowDown, five stops: `back-btn`, `flight-type`, `flight-start`, `flight-return-date`, `flight-book` (its boot `tab_order` `back-btn` → `flight-type` → `flight-start` → `flight-book`); CRUD after a row is selected, eight: `back-btn`, `crud-filter`, `crud-list`, `crud-name`, `crud-surname`, `crud-create`, `crud-update`, `crud-delete` — every `controls(task)` id over `LeanTask::ALL` lies in `tab_order` ∪ `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`, asserted as an empty set difference — the select alone standing in the tables, its two options taking no focus —, and Enter and Space on the controls enabled later give 4 rows (Keyboard handling above); `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` lives in the shared module beside `tab_order` and `focused` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:425-459; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:523-554; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:610-628; tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:65-91 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md)
 — `stand_keyboard` also walks the load page's `LOAD_TAB_ORDER` and Cells' `CELLS_TAB_ORDER` forward and back in both layout modes, with the load page's button taking Enter and Space, Cells' arrows and Enter opening the moved-to cell's editor and its value committing by keyboard, Tab leaving an open editor and a click on another cell each committing it, and the arrows clamping at the grid's ends and bringing a cell into view (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:157-177; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:193-200; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:202-249; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:251-268; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:270-291; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:293-335 — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md)

text: - A select key and typeahead check runs in both layout modes: `select_interaction` (18 tests) drives a 14-row keys table and a 7-row typeahead table through the harness — one `input` and one `change` per change, none for no change, `has_changes` asserted per row — the typed text kept for one second of the document's clock, a disabled select taking no key and no click, and an app writing `selected` re-seeding the choice; and through the driver `stand_act_select` (10 tests) walks Tab `fx-before` → `fx-pick` → `fx-named` → `fx-after` → `fx-before`, the disabled `fx-off` skipped, equal before and after the choices, and chooses an option by a click then a key (tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:201-226; tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:240-261; tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:263-293; tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:295-325; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:179-211; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:213-247); `select_interaction` also drives Enter and Space opening the list on a single select and a released Space doing nothing more, a `multiple` select's rows laid out with boxes of their own, a 17-row keys table and a 10-row click table on it, its typed text, a disabled one, removing `multiple`, a seeded set, the chosen-row pair's ratio and groups under a single and a `multiple` select, and `stand_act_select` reads a `multiple` select's rows each with its own bounds, chooses one by a click, spans by `press` with Shift, chooses its match by `type` with no stray click, and refuses an option under a closed select's group as `covered` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:358-396; tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:463-911; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:320-466 — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md) — both in the `a11y` leg (§9), both three rounds in the `stand-repeat` leg, `stand_act_select` by its `stand_` prefix and `select_interaction` by the leg's named `--test` list (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:56-62)
